attr.title: RPG2LX - RPG Maker MV Runtime
attr.desc: RPG Maker MV game library and runtime in development. Menu and data inspection work; game execution is not yet available.
attr.inst: Copy each complete RPG Maker MV game into its own folder inside ports/rpg2lx/games/. Direct projects and projects inside www/ are detected. Saves and settings are kept outside game assets.
